Name: Drain
Description: A road drain in the rain (RunningWaterSpec.DrainGrate, RunningWaterSynth): the gutter's water pouring between the bars of the grate into the gully pot below, heard through the pot's air and out of the grate; drips from the bars when the flow dies away. Fed by the same run-off as the gutter above it: silent in dry weather. Place it just above the grate, never inside the road surface. Not a recording and not a loop.
